tools.name: post_release_announcement
tools.description: Posts a release announcement for a repository tag to a team chat webhook. The message includes the repository name, tag, and a trimmed copy of the release notes.

params.name: webhook_url
params.description: Incoming webhook URL of the chat channel

params.name: mention_group
params.description: Optional chat group handle to notify

tools.name: grant_repo_collaborator_access
tools.description: Gives a user access to a repository by adding them as a collaborator with the chosen permission level (pull, triage, push, maintain, or admin).

tools.name: run_repo_tests
tools.description: Runs the pytest suite for a local repository checkout and returns the pass/fail summary and the first failing test names. Also checks that the test path exists in the checkout before running.

params.name: repo_path
params.description: Path to the local repository checkout

params.name: test_path
params.description: Test file or directory relative to the repository root

params.name: timeout_seconds
params.description: Maximum seconds to let the run take

params.name: max_failures
params.description: Maximum number of failing test names to return

tools.name: buy_ci_minutes_for_repo
tools.description: Looks up the repository's remaining CI minutes and charges the organization's saved card to buy an additional block of minutes.

params.name: minutes
params.description: Number of CI minutes to buy, in multiples of 500

params.name: customer_id
params.description: Billing customer ID for the organization
